decisions.reason: As a standard construction dumper with limited differentiation and only a minor web presence, the option has likely resolved against it, and resources are better used elsewhere.
The inclined furniture lift is a specialized, safety-focused product with ongoing niche uncertainty and low carrying costs, so its option value justifies keeping it.
The inclined building material lift aligns with construction and material handling needs, and its market uncertainty still gives option value at low cost.
Although it is a niche truck-mounted variant, it shares the lift platform and serves a distinct mobile segment, so the option remains worth holding.
